name: Bad Relationships
overview: Scripture teaches that relationships must be rooted in unity and agreement, as Amos 3:3 emphasizes that two cannot walk together unless they are agreed. God’s design for marriage is one of committed unity, where a man leaves his parents to be joined to his wife as one flesh (Genesis 2:24). True relationships honor God’s commandments and reflect His will, calling believers to be transformed and not conformed to worldly patterns (John 14:15; Romans 12:2). Trusting in God's plan and timing brings peace and hope, as Jeremiah 29:11 and Ecclesiastes 3:1 remind us that there is purpose and season for every aspect of life.
